posts.content:
Another great visibility hack for your SaaS is the "1-to-6 Package Syndicate" via npm (DR 92) and PyPI (DR 91).

When you publish one tiny CLI or MCP wrapper for your SaaS, it automatically spawns 6 additional high-authority pages without you submitting anywhere else:

- Google's deps .dev (DR 92)
- jsDelivr CDN (DR 89 - dofollow)
- UNPKG (DR 86)
- Libraries .io (DR 75 - renders all deep links in your README as dofollow)

Here is how to do it:

1. Have a public API or remote MCP endpoint for your SaaS.
2. Ask Claude Code to wrap it into a zero-dependency CLI/MCP package.
3. In package.json and pyproject.toml, fill in `homepage`, `repository`, and a README with 3-4 deep links to your core documentation pages.
4. Run `npm publish --access public` and `twine upload dist/*`.

A few notes:

- Those 6 auto-generated mirror pages are often orphan pages at first. Link to all 6 of them from your GitHub repo's README or GitHub Pages site so Googlebot indexes the entire cluster within 24 hours.
posts.author: Khoa AI | AEORank.app
posts.notes: 在 npm 和 PyPI 发布 tiny CLI/MCP wrapper，自动获得 deps.dev、jsDelivr、UNPKG、Libraries.io 等 6 个高 DR 专页外链。

Another great visibility hack for your SaaS is to get listed on LobeHub (DR 75). You get a dedicated page and a dofollow link.

Here is how:

1. Put your MCP server in a public GitHub repo with a detailed README (ask Claude to do it for you). LobeHub builds your page from it.
2. Install the CLI with npm i -g @ lobehub/market-cli, then run lhm login and lhm github connect.
3. Add an lhm.plugin.json with a name, version and your MCP URL, then run lhm plugin publish.

A few notes:

Every link in your README shows up on the page, and they're all dofollow. Link your homepage and signup page.
